description.value: Parallel 49 Street Kitchen is the on-site restaurant at Parallel 49 Brewing Company, self-described as one of BC's largest craft brewery restaurants, with 40+ beers on tap and a fully stocked indoor food truck as its kitchen concept. Founded in 2012 by six partners and rooted in Pacific Northwest craft beer culture, the brewery uses locally sourced regional ingredients and also offers house-made non-alcoholic sodas including root beer and ginger beer. A touring cyclist arriving here would find a lively, full-service brewery taproom with a broad beer selection and a reservation-friendly dining experience.

address.value: 1950 Triumph Street, Vancouver, BC, Canada V5L 1K5

concerns: OSM assigns this record to the 'North Vancouver' community, but the website address is 1950 Triumph Street, Vancouver, BC V5L 1K5 — this postal code and street are in East Vancouver, not North Vancouver. The OSM community tag may be incorrect and should be verified.

Bike parking and other cycling-specific amenities should be verified on-site before publishing the listing.
